    def find_sequence(n, k):
        if n == 1:
            return [1] if k == 0 else -1
        if n == 2:
            return [k, 1] if k > 0 else -1
        if k < n // 2:
            return -1

        sequence = list(range(1, n + 1))
        current_k = 0
        i = 0
        while i < n - 1 and current_k < k:
            current_k += math.gcd(sequence[i], sequence[i + 1])
            sequence[i] *= sequence[i + 1]
            sequence.pop(i + 1)
            n -= 1

        if current_k < k:
            return -1

        while current_k > k:
            if sequence[-1] % 2 == 0:
                sequence[-1] //= 2
                sequence.append(sequence[-1] + 1)
                current_k -= 1
            elif sequence[-1] % 3 == 0:
                sequence[-1] //= 3
                sequence.append(sequence[-1] * 2)
                current_k -= 1
            else:
                return -1

        return sequence

    input = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    n, k = map(int, input.split())
    result = find_sequence(n, k)
    if result == -1:
        print(-1)
    else:
        print(" ".join(map(str, result)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
